adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `attendeesListPromises` maps over `bookingAttendees.attendees` (which includes pre-existing attendees plus newly created ones) and does `translate: await getTranslation(attendee.locale ?? "en", "common")` for each attendee. Since the translation function depends only on `locale`, this repeats i18n loading/instantiation N times for attendees sharing the same locale and could be deduped/cached per distinct locale. This is a performance/efficiency concern, not a correctness defect shown by the diff.
